intro: The Binding is the final initiation in an Undercity warlock's journey to summon and command a succubus. Directed by Carendin Halgar, the practitioner uses pure hearts to draw a demon from the Twisting Nether into a ritual circle, subjugating its will through combat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Using these hearts, cast a spell at the summoning circle to open a doorway for the succubus to come through. Your powers are greater now, and you will need all of them to defeat the succubus.
Beware its charms, friend, many a strong mind has been bound to its will. When overcome, the succubus will be returned to the void, and I will teach you the spell to summon it forth at your command.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Of the powers from beyond the void, the succubus is one of the most dangerous, as the weak are most easily wrapped around its fingers.
Remember that now and in the future.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Again, you have done well, friend. It has been quite some time since I have seen a young warlock with as much potential as you. Be assured that I will continue to watch your progress, and prepare and assist you in your future trials.
For now, let me show you the summoning spell for your newly dominated succubus.
